subject: Pilot deployment economics — decision tradeoffs and bridge plan
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Evans <tom.evans@artemisai.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Pilot deployment economics — decision tradeoffs and bridge plan

Hi Tom / Marta —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap from our side and a recommended bridge plan so Artemis can move from POC to a low-risk pilot while we firm up the long-term deployment choice. I attached the call notes and a draft cost workbook.

Key takeaways (from your product & ops context):
- Peak production inference: ~120k tokens/day, 95th p50 latency requirement ~250ms for chat flows.
- Burstiness: 3x spikes during peak business hours; sustained baseline much lower.
- Data constraints: logs retained 90 days for now; eventual plan to put sensitive pipelines inside a VPC.

Redwood deployment options and quick economics:
- Hosted API (per-token): fastest to launch, predictable per-token spend, no infra ops but less controller over VPC/inbound network. Good if volume remains elastic.
- Dedicated (reserved capacity): monthly reserved GPU pools. Lower per-token cost at sustained usage and supports tighter latency SLOs + KV-cache locality; requires commit and modest provisioning lead time.
- Private (VPC / on-prem): required if you need complete network isolation and KMS/HSM integration; higher fixed platform fees, longer lead times.

Recommended bridge plan (to mitigate risk while we finalize commitments):
1) Start pilot on Hosted API for first 30 days (fast onboarding, validate prompt sets, error modes).
2) Enable prefix caching + burst protection; add continuous batching suggestions from Redwood Optimize.
3) After 30 days, re-evaluate: if steady-state tokens > 2M/day equivalent, move to Dedicated reserved pool (we'll model commit levels). If you require VPC for compliance gates, we prepare Private deployment parallel path.

Action items / asks:
- Marta/Tom: confirm whether Artemis can run initial pilot data in Hosted mode (no VPN) for 30 days.
- Marcus/Laura: can you produce a 3-tier reserved capacity math (low/expected/high) we can share with their finance team?
- I will send a simple TCO sheet with per-token vs capacity scenarios by tomorrow.

Thanks —
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Tom Evans <tom.evans@artemisai.com>

Cc: Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@artemisai.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Dec 2026 09:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot deployment economics — decision tradeoffs and bridge plan

Jasmine —

Appreciate the clear recap. Short answers: yes to Hosted pilot for 30 days (we want to validate latency & correctness first). Finance will need a clear comparison of per-token vs reserved for the expected run-rate. A couple of clarifying notes:
- We have a potential monthly committed budget ceiling of $35k for Q1 if the numbers make sense.
- Compliance: we can run the pilot off-hosted, but after pilot we may need a VPC for the highest-sensitivity flows (about 20% of requests).

Please include tokenization assumptions in the TCO (we use a mixture of chat + long-context extraction with avg 520 tokens per request in production). Also include an example break-even commit level.

Tom
Head of Platform Engineering | Artemis AI
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Evans <tom.evans@artemisai.com>, Marta Ruiz <marta.ruiz@artemisai.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Dec 2026 11:38:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot deployment economics — decision tradeoffs and bridge plan

Team —

Sharing the initial math (attached as redwood-pilot-cost-sheet-20261217.xlsx). High-level notes:
- Assumptions included on the cost sheet: tokenization rate 520 tokens/request, avg response tokens 180, baseline 120k tokens/day, peak burst factor 3x.
- Hosted per-token: $0.00045/token (generation + context) in our standard pricing example -> monthly ~$1,620 for baseline (120k tokens/day) but ~4.8k at 3x peak; numbers scale linearly.
- Dedicated reserved example: 1x A6000-equivalent pool (24/7) reduces per-token equivalent to ~$0.00018 at baseline after overhead amortization across utilization; but requires a 12-month commit or monthly reserved billing (we modeled month-to-month vs 12m commit).
- Private deployment: we modeled a setup fee + platform license ~ $40k one-time + support; lower unit cost only at very high sustained throughput and where data residency is necessary.

Break-even guidance: if average sustained tokens > ~2.5M/day (after eviction of cache savings) Dedicated commit becomes more economical within 3–6 months. Caching & batching can shift that threshold down 15–25%.

Next steps I propose:
- Jasmine: send the simplified one-page per-token vs reserved comparison and a recommended commit band (we can present three commit tiers: Starter, Growth, Enterprise).
- Laura: prep a one-slide VPC onboarding timeline (network work, certs) in case they confirm 20% sensitive traffic needs Private or VPC-secure Dedicated.

Marcus
Head of Solutions | Redwood Inference
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Evans <tom.evans@artemisai.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 10:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pilot deployment economics — decision tradeoffs and bridge plan

Tom / Marta —

Thanks — attaching the simplified TCO and the commit bands (Starter / Growth / Enterprise). High level ask: if you can confirm by next Tues (12/22) which commit band Artemis is comfortable provisioning for an optional Dedicated conversion, we’ll reserve a capacity slot to match your expected go-live window in early Jan. If not, we’ll proceed with Hosted pilot and make the Dedicated conversion a fast follow once you hit the thresholds.

Quick checklist for your team to confirm during pilot:
- Validate 95th p50 latency at your average window with prefix cache on.
- Run the data-sensitivity pass to identify which flows need VPC isolation.
- Confirm whether finance can commit to a 6 vs 12 month reserved option (we'll show both).

I’ll schedule a 30-min review session for Mon 12/21 — Marcus / Vivek / Laura will join to walk through the TCO and answer technical questions.

Best,
Jasmine
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
